In CNIL’s practical AI guidance sheets, age information should be handled by prioritizing the least intrusive format without losing relevant information for the intended purpose. For example, it is recommended to use age or age ranges instead of complete birth dates. 

In the context of a diagnosis-aid system, the guidance suggests that generalizing age information (e.g., using [month-year] or [year] instead of [day-month-year]) can significantly reduce the risk of loss of confidentiality while still maintaining the system's ability to generalize effectively.
